editorial: When the upside‑down universe crashes into Paris, the skyline feels more like a carnival ride than a city map. The twist that Ladybug’s arch‑villains are the bad guys in this parallel realm flips a familiar hero story into a mirror‑image duel you can’t ignore. Every chase spins into a dazzling jazz‑driven spectacle that keeps your ears on high gear. If cheerful action that challenges heroism is your guilty pleasure, this colorful chaos will match that craving. Yet the mid‑act stretches a bit, making the stakes feel only just as urgent.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of action‑comedy anime who enjoy playful world‑building and spirited humor.
